subject.facility_name: BEACON BROOK CENTER FOR HEALTH & REHABILITATION

executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $207.13 per resident day (44.9% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was -7.9% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $466,941, 5.2% of the $8,953,723 direct care cost.

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $1,423,365, $32.93 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $728,925 (51.2%), allocated fringe $226,162 (15.9%), non-wage costs $468,278 (32.9%). Raw food was $387,197 ($8.96 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.61) and purchased dietary services $45,852.
Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost $687,350, $15.9 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.32). Wages $472,578 (68.8%), allocated fringe $146,626 (21.3%), non-wage costs $68,146 (9.9%).
Cost year 2025: laundry cost $268,860, $6.22 per resident day (Connecticut median $5.66). Wages $143,547 (53.4%), allocated fringe $44,538 (16.6%), non-wage costs $80,775 (30.0%).
Missing data: cost years 2015, 2016, 2017 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data)

missing_data.reason: Cost year 2015 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (resident days vs beds outside the plausible range; direct care per resident day outside the plausible range; payer days do not add up to the printed total). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

Cost year 2016 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (direct care per resident day outside the plausible range; direct care share of expenses outside the plausible range; core figures (days, revenue or expenses) could not be read; payer days do not add up to the printed total). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

Cost year 2017 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (direct care per resident day outside the plausible range; core figures (days, revenue or expenses) could not be read). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
